primitives.name: Secret Immutability Law
primitives.verbatim_quote: # OPERATOR — production actions agents cannot perform **Law:** never invent secrets.
primitives.assumptions: Agents cannot alter S; I is binary (0 or 1).
primitives.breakdown_regime: S remains invariant under agent action.

layer2.mapping: GSI Bayesian prior over secret integrity maps to GSE deterministic state transition.

primitives.name: Free Settlement Dominance
primitives.verbatim_quote: Free settlement recovery (highest leverage if settle stuck) Since 2026-09-02 (`apps/web/lib/settlement/path-select.ts` `selectSettlementPlan`) the free grader (ESPN + registered consensus) is the **primary** pass on every settle-picks cycle regardless of `THE_ODDS_API_KEY` — a present key only adds a paid `settleSport` **supplement** afterwards for whatever the free pass left `PENDING`.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{P}_{\\text{free}}(S)': 'Probability of settlement success via free path', '\\mathcal{P}_{\\text{paid}}(S)': 'Probability of settlement success via paid supplement', '\\mathcal{S}': 'Set of settlement states'}
primitives.assumptions: Free path is deterministic and more reliable than paid path.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Paid path fails when free path is insufficient.

layer2.mapping: GSE settlement engine prioritizes free-grade logic as kernel, with paid-grade as fallback kernel.
layer2.telemetry: Settlement completion time and pending state count.

primitives.name: Key Failure Isolation
primitives.verbatim_quote: A dead/deactivated key fails only the supplement (`paidSupplement.failedSports`, `advisories[]` in the response); it no longer blocks the free grader the way it did before this law.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{F}_{\\text{key}}(T)': 'Failure indicator of key state T', 'T': 'Key state (dead, active, deactivated)'}
primitives.assumptions: Key failure does not propagate to free-grade logic.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Free-grade logic operates independently of key validity.

layer2.mapping: GSE isolates key failure to paid-grade module, maintaining free-grade integrity.
layer2.telemetry: Paid supplement failure count and advisory logs.

The operator enforces two core principles: secret immutability and free settlement dominance. The first primitive establishes that agents cannot invent secrets, forming a foundational constraint on information flow. The second primitive defines a probabilistic dominance where the free settlement path is always executed first, with paid supplements acting as refinements. This creates a layered inference model where GSI evaluates settlement confidence by weighting free-grade outcomes against paid-grade uncertainty. Key failure is isolated to paid-grade modules, ensuring that system resilience is maintained even when external data sources fail. The third primitive formalizes this isolation, enabling GSE to maintain operational continuity by decoupling key validity from core settlement logic. These primitives form a dual structure: one enforcing logical consistency (secrets) and another enforcing operational robustness (settlement paths).
